## famine — talking to Lena
> YOU PICK [dlg:help] 
YOU: "How can I help?"
NPC: "It's handled. Really — it is. I appreciate you asking, though."

> YOU PICK [alive:event:naming] 
YOU: "What’s going on out there?"
NPC: "Have you heard what they're calling The Moderator? Lena is pushing 'The Ugly Beast'. Everyone's got a name for it and nobody agrees."

> YOU PICK [gq:yn:yes] 
YOU: "Yes."
NPC: "The way I read it — Yeah. Thought so — and I'm glad it's you saying it."

> YOU PICK [alive:thread:want] 
YOU: "About that favor — we never finished."
NPC: "All sorted. Some things just work out."

> YOU PICK [alive:thread:lately] 
YOU: "About what's been happening — we never finished."
NPC: "I'm staying out of the naming fight. For now. Someone always gets precious about their pick."

> YOU PICK [goon] 
YOU: "Keep going."
NPC: "I should go. You know where to find me."

> YOU PICK [goon] 
YOU: "Keep going."
NPC: "When's the last time you really laughed?"

> YOU PICK [ans:q_laugh_memory:a_tell] 
(conversation ended by the engine)

NPC: "Stealing joy. I like that. We should steal more of it."

## famine — talking to Nathan
> YOU PICK [dlg:help] 
YOU: "How can I help?"
NPC: "No, really, it's fine. Forget I even asked."

> YOU PICK [betrayal:accept] 
YOU: "Sure."
NPC: Nathan has been stockpiling where nobody looks. "Take half. You've got the hands for it." (+4 wood, +4 fiber to the village stash.)

> YOU PICK [alive:event:naming] 
YOU: "What’s going on out there?"
NPC: "The whole fire was arguing about The Moderator last night — what to even CALL it. 'Don't-Look' got shouted down. What's your vote?"

> YOU PICK [gq:open:take] 
YOU: "What do you think?"
NPC: "You really want my take? ...Yeah. Okay. I think we're being tested."

> YOU PICK [alive:thread:want] 
YOU: "About that favor — we never finished."
NPC: "...Actually, forget it."

> YOU PICK [alive:thread:lately] 
NPC: "Names are for when it's dead or known. Right now it's neither, so I tend the fire without being asked instead."
NPC: "Let me sit with all that. We'll pick it up later."

> YOU PICK [dlg:more] 
(conversation ended by the engine)

## famine — talking to Emma

YOU: "What do you think?"
NPC: "Listen — My take? We're not going to like the answer, whatever it is."

> YOU PICK [dlg:help]

NPC: "The fire'll settle it. It settles everything, eventually."
